options.name: drop_ins
options.description: A list of possible systemd drop-ins. The structure corresponds exactly to that of a normal unit file.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the unit file.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether to install (C(present) or remove (C(absent) a unit file. Default is C(present).

options.name: unit_file
options.description: The content of a systemd unit file.

options.name: unit_type
options.description: The unit type to be created. The (C(service), C(timer) and C(socket)) types are supported. Default is C(service).
